sheets.title: Access rail, Grants open (1280 × 800)
sheets.caption: The six Access tabs are siblings under access/. Before, Grants and Sessions drew a caret while the other four collapsed into caret-less rows one indent to the left, so the tabs looked nested in each other. Grants' panels had carets that opened onto nothing.
sheets.before: tab names at x=52,33,52,33,33,33; carets on 2 of 6 tabs; empty caret on Local application grants
sheets.after: tab names all at x=52; carets on 6 of 6 tabs; Local application grants is a plain row at x=67 beside Identity shares

sheets.title: Access rail, Requests and Sessions open (1280 × 800)
sheets.caption: Requests had no subtree, so it could not open at all, and Sessions sat one indent right of it. Now Requests opens onto Local requests, and both tabs open onto their panels at the same level.
sheets.before: Requests: no caret, x=33; Sessions: caret, x=52; 3 empty carets under Sessions
sheets.after: Requests and Sessions both carets at x=52; panels are plain rows

sheets.title: Settings rail (1280 × 800), same rail rule
sheets.caption: The alignment rule belongs to the rail, not to Access. Settings had the same defect: General and Danger have nothing to open and sat one indent left of Security, Vaults and Capabilities.
sheets.before: General, Danger at x=33; Security, Vaults, Capabilities at x=52

sheets.title: Phone (390 × 844): unchanged
sheets.caption: A phone has no rail. The Sections drawer lists sections only, never an Access subtree, so there is nothing to change at this width. This pair shows it is identical.
